$comment: Issue #44: the quick look, a short guided tour of what the app can do, offered once after the opening (#30). Each step is a tour stop (src/data/tours.ts, #28) plus what the tour format cannot say: `spot`, the one control that does it (it glows while the step shows); `flash`, a flash of light sent from that body when the step begins (#27); `compare`, worlds drawn side by side in the card (#24). The words are in src/locales/<locale>/ui.json under solarSystem.quickLook.steps.<id>. See docs/ARCHITECTURE.md, 'The quick look'.
